placements.why: The envelope's content is a database/tooling adoption decision for an analytics pipeline — a technical infrastructure choice. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and none of Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Organization/Proof/Templates/Calibration (as category types) plausibly holds an architecture-grade tooling decision; Architecture is the natural, standalone home and needs no ancestor minted first.
placements.title: System and infrastructure architecture decisions
placements.frame: What underlying system or infrastructure architecture is being chosen, changed, or migrated, and what technical rationale drives it?

placements.title: Analytics workloads shifting to specialized columnar database infrastructure
placements.frame: Which database or analytics tooling is being adopted for analytics workloads, and what performance evidence and migration timeline accompany that choice over time?
placements.why: All four expressions cohere around one recurring subject future envelopes will keep feeding: which analytics database the org runs, why (columnar query performance), and when it moves (migration timeline). Src-1 and src-4 declare the adoption, src-3 sets the migration timeline, and src-2's 15x performance figure is the rationale evidencing this same theme rather than a leaf of its own (grain test: the statistic is a fact supporting the tooling-choice narrative, not a standalone subject). No existing narrative leaf exists in this repo to reuse, so this is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
